UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Represents a student's profile within Study Buddy AI.

id.description: Unique identifier for the UserProfile entity.

LearningContent.title: LearningContent
LearningContent.description: Represents a piece of educational content available in the library.

id.description: Unique identifier for the LearningContent entity.

title.description: The title of the learning content.

type.description: The type of learning content (e.g., article, video, simulation).

url.description: The URL where the learning content can be accessed.

subject.description: Subject that the learning content falls under.

Progress.title: Progress
Progress.description: Represents a student's progress on a specific topic or learning content.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Progress entity.

completionDate.description: The date and time when the student completed the content.

score.description: The student's score on the content, if applicable.

firestore.reasoning: The Firestore structure is designed to ensure authorization independence, clarity, and scalability for the Study Buddy AI application. User profiles are stored in a dedicated collection (`/userProfiles`) for easy management and clear ownership.  Learning content is stored in the `/learningContent` collection. User-specific progress is located under the `/userProfiles/{userProfileId}/progress/{progressId}` path. The `buddyverseConsoleData` is stored in a separate `/buddyverseConsoleData` collection to decouple it from user data, with updates triggered when data is added to this collection. This structure uses path-based ownership for user data and segregates data with different access requirements into distinct collections, simplifying security rules and ensuring efficient queries. This design supports QAPs by allowing secure listing of learning content and progress within a user's scope.
